outcome: time between caesarean section and ambulation
duration of first rescue analgesic requirement
cohort: The study included 90 postpartum women who underwent caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Combination analgesia of Diclofenac suppository with paracetamol infusion resulted in the least pain (VAS score) and lowest requirement for rescue analgesia compared to tramadol suppository plus paracetamol infusion or paracetamol infusion alone.
